description.value: Tidal Café is a locally owned breakfast, brunch, and lunch spot in Comox, BC, situated just steps from the Comox marina and voted Best Breakfast/Brunch in the Comox Valley five consecutive years (2021–2025). Founded by husband-and-wife Kurt and Blythe Reimer, the cafe serves thoughtfully sourced ingredients across a menu spanning signature bowls, eggs benedicts, espresso drinks, and craft brews, with strong vegan options. The relaxed, dog-friendly patio and welcoming family atmosphere make it a natural gathering point for cyclists exploring the northern Vancouver Island coastline.
